terms.definition: The required material was not supplied.
The condition or field was not observed in the eligible evidence.
The material is known or expected but unavailable to the current evidence process.
Material exists but is not eligible under the governing source or method contract.
A required computation cannot be validly performed from the available eligible inputs.
Material is intentionally withheld under a declared disclosure, privacy, security, or licensing condition.
Only part of the required material or scope is available.
Eligible materials conflict in a way that remains unresolved.
